questions.prompt: Explain how blood sugar level is kept steady by feedback.
questions.modelAnswer: After a meal, blood glucose rises. The pancreas detects this and releases insulin, which helps cells take in glucose and the liver store it, so blood sugar falls. As the level returns to normal, the pancreas releases less insulin. This is a feedback mechanism: the effect of the hormone controls how much is released.
rubric: Less released as level falls: feedback
